title: nzbfast
descript: Fast Usenet downloader - single-binary daemon with web dashboard, SABnzbd/NZBGet-compatible API and built-in indexer. Packaged for TerraMaster TOS 7: the official Docker Hub image runs as a container on your NAS, keeps its data in the application data folder (so it survives restarts and updates), and is opened from its desktop icon.
important: First run: open the web UI and complete the initial setup. Data lives in /Volume1/DockerAppData/nzbfastdocker/ and survives restarts and updates. The container runs as uid 1000, so mounted folders must be readable by that user. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the application data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

github.description: The fast Usenet downloader. One self-contained executable: line-rate downloads, one-pass verify and extract, poster wall, built-in indexer. Speaks the SABnzbd and NZBGet APIs, so Sonarr, Radarr, nzb360 and LunaSea connect unmodified

zh-cn.descript: Usenet NZB 下载器，带 Web 界面。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/nzbfastdocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。
